title: Melstroymod
description: This mod adds a meme wheel of melstroy meme phrases
body:
REQUIRES FABRIC API

Melstroy Mod a Minecraft mod that adds a sound menu with Melstroy meme audio.

Press V to open the menu and manually play sounds anytime. Perfect for fun or trolling friends

Meme wheel keybind can be changed in the settings

Mod also has a russian and english localization
